details.question: Does the 2022 Tesla Model Y have any NHTSA recall involving air bags? Give the campaign number(s) or say none.
details.answer: None. The NHTSA recall data for the 2022 Tesla Model Y lists eight campaigns (22V037000, 21V912000, 22V045000, 22V050000, 22V063000, 22V235000, 22V296000, 22V702000) covering ADAS software, suspension, seat-belt chime, heat-pump/defrosting, pedestrian-warning sound, CPU overheating, and power-window controls — none involve air bags.
